prompts.text: Name a word that reads the same backwards
prompts.note: Names count too, and so does a whole phrase if you can pull one off in time.

answers.name: Was it a car or a cat I saw
A man a plan a canal Panama
Mr Owl ate my metal worm

prompts.text: Name a word that goes before 'ball'
prompts.note: Together they make a thing: 'football', 'beach ball'. Type the word, or the whole thing.

prompts.text: Name a word that comes after 'water'
prompts.note: Together they make a thing: 'waterfall', 'water bottle'. Type the word, or the whole thing.

prompts.text: Name a colour that's also the name of something else
prompts.note: A colour named after a fruit, a stone, an animal, a place...: 'orange', 'lime'. Plain 'red' doesn't count.

decoys.name: Red
decoys.why: Plain red is only ever a colour!

prompts.text: Name an English word that came from Malay, Chinese or Tamil
prompts.note: Words in ordinary English dictionaries, like 'amok' or 'kung fu'. Food counts! Singlish doesn't, lah.

decoys.name: Pyjamas
decoys.why: That one's from Hindi and Persian.

prompts.text: Name something to eat or drink that starts with K
prompts.note: Dishes, snacks, fruit, veg and drinks all count, and so do brands you can eat.

decoys.name: Kopitiam
decoys.why: That's where you eat, not what you eat!

prompts.text: Name an animal that starts with B
prompts.note: Any animal at all: wild, farm, pet, bird, fish or bug. Breeds count.

decoys.name: Batman
decoys.why: A man dressed as a bat doesn't count.

decoys.name: Bulbasaur
decoys.why: That's a Pokémon, not an animal!
